project: 1232 N. Jefferson St. — New Detached ADU, Placentia CA

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: PMC § 23.73.060(C) — 4 ft minimum side setbacks for detached ADUs in R-1 zones
city_amendments_applied.note: City and state are aligned at 4 ft. Enforcement basis: PMC § 23.73.060(C).

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: PMC § 23.73.060(D) — 10 ft minimum separation between new detached ADU and primary dwelling
city_amendments_applied.state_default: State law does not specify a minimum building separation for detached ADUs
city_amendments_applied.note: Objective standard — enforceable. Not shown on submitted plans.

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: PMC § 23.73.080 — ADU exterior materials and roof pitch shall be compatible with the primary dwelling (objective standard)
city_amendments_applied.state_default: Gov. Code § 66314(b)(1) — only objective design standards permitted
city_amendments_applied.note: Standard is objective (materials match, roof pitch match) — enforceable. Plans do not include a compatibility statement or material comparison table.

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: PMC Ch. 23.12 (R-1 Zone) — maximum 50% lot coverage
city_amendments_applied.state_default: Gov. Code § 66321(b)(3) — local lot coverage limits may apply
city_amendments_applied.note: Estimated coverage ~40.7% (6,645 sq ft lot; SFR 1,854 sq ft + ADU 850 sq ft). Appears to comply but calculation is not stated on plans.

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: Placentia adopts state energy code; 2022 California Energy Code (Title 24, Part 6) effective January 1, 2023
city_amendments_applied.note: For 2026 submittals, the 2022 CEnC applies. Plans reference 2019 Title 24 — must be updated.

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: PMC § 23.73.050 — deed restriction recorded with Orange County Recorder restricting ADU to residential use and notifying owners of owner-occupancy waiver (per AB 976) required before permit issuance
city_amendments_applied.state_default: State law limits deed restriction requirements — no owner-occupancy restriction permitted after Jan 1, 2025 (AB 976). Recordation of non-sale covenant is permissible.
city_amendments_applied.note: Deed restriction for non-rental-ban purposes is permissible. Plans do not reference this requirement — applicant must record before building permit is issued.

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: Placentia Development Impact Fees — proportional fee applies to ADUs >750 sq ft per AB 68 framework
city_amendments_applied.state_default: Gov. Code § 66333.1 — no impact fee for ADUs ≤750 sq ft; proportional fee for larger ADUs
city_amendments_applied.note: Proposed ADU is 850 sq ft — 100 sq ft above the fee exemption threshold. Proportional impact fee applies. Not a plan correction, but applicant should be informed.

city_amendments_applied.local_rule: Placentia is served by Golden State Water Company (GSWC) — applicant must coordinate directly with GSWC for new water service lateral and meter; city does not process water utility connections
city_amendments_applied.state_default: State law permits connection to existing water/sewer systems
city_amendments_applied.note: Informational only — ADU may connect to existing service lateral per state law, but GSWC coordination required for any new meter or service upgrade.

new_city_findings.check: Building separation — ADU to primary dwelling (10 ft minimum)
new_city_findings.code_ref: PMC § 23.73.060(D) — 10 ft minimum separation between detached ADU and primary dwelling. No building separation dimension is labeled on new site plan (A1) between ADU and existing SFR.
new_city_findings.action: INCLUDE — dimension building separation between ADU and primary dwelling on site plan.

new_city_findings.check: Architectural compatibility — materials and roof pitch match primary dwelling
new_city_findings.code_ref: PMC § 23.73.080 — exterior materials and roof pitch of ADU shall be compatible with primary dwelling (objective standard). No compatibility note or material comparison table present on architectural sheets.
new_city_findings.action: INCLUDE — add compatibility note on A3 or cover sheet confirming ADU exterior materials and roof pitch match primary dwelling. Provide material callout if not already shown.

new_city_findings.check: Deed restriction — recorded before permit issuance
new_city_findings.code_ref: PMC § 23.73.050 — deed restriction with Orange County Recorder required before building permit issuance. Restriction must note ADU is for residential use only and acknowledge AB 976 owner-occupancy waiver.
new_city_findings.action: INFORMATIONAL — not a plan correction. Applicant must record deed restriction with OC Recorder and provide copy to Planning Division before building permit is issued.

new_city_findings.check: Impact fee notice — proportional fee applies (ADU >750 sq ft)
new_city_findings.code_ref: Gov. Code § 66333.1 + Placentia Development Impact Fee Schedule — no impact fee for ADUs ≤750 sq ft; proportional fee applies for ADUs 751–1,000 sq ft. Proposed ADU is 850 sq ft.
new_city_findings.action: INFORMATIONAL — not a plan correction. Applicant should be advised proportional impact fee applies at permit issuance.
